selection: Fixed last update, no development selection; freeze all forty weights before generating final diagnostic queries or running final rollouts.
primary: Mean paired seed difference in balanced accuracy on deterministic held-out sufficient COMMIT input types; each seed is one replicate.
secondary: Equal-type accuracy, confusion counts, eligible/active strata; paired autonomous success and native steps; no final-test tuning.
accounting: Per model: exactly 3000 native component targets plus 3600 auxiliary confirmation targets. Shared auxiliary contexts supply native P/C values to both arms and are separately charged (7200 root values, plus full neighbor conditioning values). Simulation, conditioning computation, rejected candidates, duplicate queries, and optimization presentations are reported separately.
